fields.name: Mojito
fields.ingredients:
- 50 ml white rum
- 25 ml lime juice
- 2 tsp sugar
- 6 mint leaves
- soda water
fields.instructions:
1. Muddle mint with sugar and lime juice in a glass.
2. Add rum and fill with crushed ice.
3. Top with soda water and stir gently.
4. Garnish with mint sprig.

fields.name: Margarita
fields.ingredients:
- 50 ml tequila
- 25 ml triple sec
- 25 ml lime juice
- salt for rim
fields.instructions:
1. Rim the glass with salt.
2. Shake tequila, triple sec, and lime juice with ice.
3. Strain into the prepared glass.
4. Garnish with lime wedge.

fields.name: Old Fashioned
fields.ingredients:
- 60 ml bourbon
- 1 sugar cube
- 2 dashes Angostura bitters
- orange peel
fields.instructions:
1. Muddle sugar cube with bitters and a splash of water.
2. Add bourbon and large ice cube.
3. Stir until well chilled.
4. Express orange peel over the glass and garnish.

fields.name: Piña Colada
fields.ingredients:
- 50 ml white rum
- 30 ml coconut cream
- 90 ml pineapple juice
fields.instructions:
1. Blend all ingredients with ice until smooth.
2. Pour into a chilled hurricane glass.
3. Garnish with pineapple wedge and cherry.

fields.text: Perfect summer drink — mint makes all the difference!
I use a bit less sugar and more lime. Still amazing.
Classic margarita ratio — works every time with good tequila.
Stir, do not shake. The orange oils from the peel are essential.
